'''Modair Paendrag''' was the first son of King [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall]] and Queen [[Amaline Paendrag Tagora]], born in {{Fy|942}} when Tanreall was still just the King of [[Shandalle]]. Modair had a twin sister, [[Amira Paendrag]], and a younger brother and sister, whose names are unknown.

==History==
Prince Modair was anxious to prove his martial prowess to his father and became a soldier in his army during the latter stages of the [[Consolidation]]. Modair died, aged just 16 or 17, in battle in {{Fy|959}}. The location and manner of his death is unknown.

His father mourned his death and wrote a notable poem, ''Loss'', on the subject. Whilst Hawkwing was devasted, he also seems to have accepted his death in battle as a natural risk in the life of a soldier.

Hawkwing was considerably more devastated by the cowardly assassination of his wife and remaining three children two years later, which plunged him into the [[Black Years]] of his rule.
